name: io.github.steadyscrape/jobs-data-mcp
title: Jobs Data MCP (SteadyScrape)
description: Live job postings from 14+ ATS career sites (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, Ashby...) and remote jobs.

tools.name: company_jobs
tools.description: Current open roles from 1-5 company career boards, read live from the board: title, department, location, remote flag, employment type, salary when published, posting date and job URL. Give board URLs (e.g. https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/stripe, https://jobs.lever.co/acme) or platform:slug (greenhouse:stripe). Billed per job returned.

companies.description: 1-5 career board URLs or platform:slug values.

keywords.description: Optional: keep jobs whose title contains any of these.

locations.description: Optional: city, region or country names or ISO codes.

posted_within_days.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days.

limit.description: Jobs to return in total (default 20, max 50). Billed per job returned.

include_descriptions.description: Include the first 1,500 characters of each description as plain text (default false). Not billed extra.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search job titles across our index of company career boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday and more), newest first: title, company, location, remote flag, salary when published, posting date and job URL. Filter by country, location text, remote, company and posting age. Billed per job returned.

keywords.description: 1-5 job title terms, e.g. "data engineer". A job matches if its title has all words of any term.

countries.description: Optional ISO country codes or names, e.g. US, GB, Germany.

locations.description: Optional location text, e.g. Berlin, New York, California.

companies.description: Optional company names or board slugs.

posted_within_days.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days.

limit.description: Jobs to return in total (default 20, max 50). Billed per job returned.

include_descriptions.description: Include the first 1,500 characters of each description as plain text (default false). Not billed extra.

tools.name: remote_jobs
tools.description: Remote jobs from company career boards, filtered by the countries, regions or time zone the employer accepts: title, company, remote type, eligible countries and regions, seniority, salary when published, posting date and job URL. Billed per job returned.

keywords.description: Optional title keywords, e.g. "backend", "product designer". Empty = all remote jobs.

worker_countries.description: Optional: only jobs open to workers in these countries (ISO codes or names, or EU).

regions.description: Optional: e.g. Europe, EMEA, LATAM, North America.

worker_timezone.description: Optional: your UTC offset, e.g. UTC-6 or +5:30; keeps jobs within 3 hours.

seniority.description: Optional: e.g. JUNIOR, MID, SENIOR, LEAD.

posted_within_days.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days (default 14).

limit.description: Jobs to return in total (default 20, max 50). Billed per job returned.

include_descriptions.description: Include the first 1,500 characters of each description as plain text (default false). Not billed extra.

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Fetch the results of a company_jobs, search_jobs or remote_jobs call that returned a run_id because it took longer than about two minutes. Returns the status while it is still running. Free: the original run is billed.

run_id.description: The run_id from the earlier call.

limit.description: Jobs to return (default all, up to 55).

include_descriptions.description: Include the first 1,500 characters of each description as plain text (default false). Not billed extra.
